verdict.rationale: llamafile runs models entirely on-device and offline with no data sharing, and the server sandbox blocks outbound connections. A hands-on user also observed it running with zero network connection. Together this gives the user implicit control over where data lives and whether it leaves the machine. However, nothing in the evidence documents explicit retention or deletion controls; missing for 10: documented settings for conversation/log/cache retention, explicit deletion mechanisms for chat history or server slot state, and any description of what data is persisted on disk.
